name: XLA_LAUNCH_OPTIONS
description: This table contains the default values for accounting program launch options for an application and a ledger.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Default value of the accounting mode parameter. Values are D: Draft, F: Final.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_MODE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether user is allowed to override the Accounting Mode during Accounting Program submission

columns.name: SUMMARY_REPORT_FLAG
columns.description: Default value of the accounting report parameter. Values are S: Summary, D: Detail.

columns.name: SUMMARY_REPORT_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether user is allowed to override the accounting report mode during accounting program submission.

columns.name: SUBMIT_TRANSFER_TO_GL_FLAG
columns.description: Default value for the transfer to general ledger parameter.

columns.name: SUBMIT_TRANSFER_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Allows the user to override the submit transfer to general ledger option during the accounting program submission. The possible values are Y for Yes or N for No.

columns.name: SUBMIT_GL_POST_FLAG
columns.description: Default value for the general ledger posting parameter in the create accounting process.

columns.name: SUBMIT_GL_POST_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Allows the user to override the submit general ledger post option during the accounting program submission. The possible values are Y for Yes or N for No.

columns.name: ERROR_LIMIT
columns.description: Accounting program errors limit.

columns.name: PROCESSES
columns.description: Number of parallel processes used for creating accounting entries.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROCESSING_UNIT_SIZE
columns.description: Indicates the  number of documents to be processed at a time while creating  accounting entries.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GL_TRANS_PROC_UNIT_SIZE
columns.description:
Approximate batch size for GL
transfer flow. This will also be the GL Import batch size. If not specified,
the corresponding accounting processing_unit_size will be used.

columns.name: GL_TRANS_PROCESSES
columns.description:
Number of parallel processing workers used for GL transfer flow. If not specified, the corresponding accounting
processes will be used.
